# BuilderTek

> BuilderTek is a Salesforce ISV partner construction management platform that unifies RFQs, quotes, contracts, budgets, scheduling, CRM, financials, and resource management in one system.

BuilderTek serves general contractors, residential builders, remodelers, specialty contractors, and developers. The platform is built natively on Salesforce and is listed on the Salesforce AppExchange.

## Solutions

- [Request for Quote](https://buildertek.com/solutions/rfq): Create, send, and track RFQs to subcontractors and suppliers.
- [Quotes](https://buildertek.com/solutions/quote): Compare vendor quotes and convert the winning bid into a contract.
- [Contracts](https://buildertek.com/solutions/contract): Generate and manage subcontractor and client contracts.
- [Budgets](https://buildertek.com/solutions/budgets): Track committed cost, actuals, and variance against the project budget.
- [Schedule](https://buildertek.com/solutions/schedule): Build project schedules with Gantt views and dependency tracking.

## Services

- [Financial Management](https://buildertek.com/services/finance): Job costing, invoicing, change orders, and financial reporting.
- [Construction Management](https://buildertek.com/services/construction): Daily logs, submittals, RFIs, and field-to-office workflows.
- [CRM Management](https://buildertek.com/services/crm-management): Lead, opportunity, and client pipeline management on Salesforce.
- [Realty Management](https://buildertek.com/services/realty-management): Property, lot, and unit tracking across developments.
- [Resource Management](https://buildertek.com/services/resource-management): Crew, equipment, and material allocation across projects.
- [All Services](https://buildertek.com/services): Overview of the full BuilderTek service set.

## Who We Serve

- [Who We Serve](https://buildertek.com/who-we-serve): Overview of supported construction business types.
- [General Contractors](https://buildertek.com/serve/general-contractors): Multi-trade project coordination and subcontractor management.
- [Residential Builders](https://buildertek.com/serve/residential-builders): Production and custom home building workflows.
- [Remodelers](https://buildertek.com/serve/remodelers): Change-order-heavy renovation project management.
- [Specialty Contractors](https://buildertek.com/serve/specialty-contractors): Trade-specific scheduling, bidding, and field reporting.
- [Developers](https://buildertek.com/serve/developers): Multi-project portfolio, budget, and realty oversight.
